newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse slips, volume, turnover flat.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse slips, volume, turnover flat.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse fell slightly on Monday in slack activity, a feature of recent sessions which operators attribute to the holiday season.
Traders said they expected the bearish mood to keep the market in its grips at least for several more days.

Three independent indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched down by 0.24, 0.14 and 0.28 percent respectively from last Friday to 1,343, 1.437.88 and 1,840 points.
Most average prices slipped, with sluggish activity in late trading taking 30 stocks to lower closing quotes. Only 18 stocks ended higher, while five had no trade and one was suspended.
Volume and turnover stayed close to the previous session's levels of 1.7 million shares and 7.2 billion lei.

The session's light buying interest focused on the first tier, mostly on chemical plant Oltchim, Antibiotice pharmaceuticals and refrigerator maker Arctic. Oltchim closed flat at 4,150 lei, Antibiotice picked up 150 lei to 7,950 and Arctic lost 200 lei to 3,400.
The nine companies on the first tier accounted for around 88 percent of total turnover and 70 percent of overall volume.
